articles.title: Saudi-backed forces in Yemen bolster defenses near Aden to deter Houthis, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Saudi-backed forces in Yemen are deploying more troops near Aden to counter a potential Houthi advance. Officials said Tuesday that the Houthis have been trying to take the district of Tur al-Baha. Saudi-backed forces have been resisting and have now bolstered their defenses. Meanwhile, the Houthis claim an airstrike on a sponge factory in Hodeida killed at least seven people. They accuse Saudi Arabia of the attack, though the kingdom hasn't commented. In other news, Iraq has begun pumping oil through a pipeline to a Turkish Mediterranean port and hundreds of people protested in an Iranian town on Tuesday.
